steps.en: A summary report is produced after each day's agency results
steps.id: Laporan ringkasan dibuat setelah hasil agency tiap hari diproses
steps.why_en: Reports come per run, are skipped when nothing was held, and had duplicate emails.
steps.why_id: Laporan dibuat per run, dilewati bila tidak ada penahanan, dan pernah ada email ganda.

steps.en: The report shows counts of records sent, returned and held
steps.id: Laporan menampilkan jumlah record dikirim, kembali, dan ditahan
steps.why_en: The counts have shown zero for returned records in some runs.
steps.why_id: Angka record yang kembali pernah tampil nol pada beberapa run.

steps.en: Records with problems are listed in the report
steps.id: Record yang bermasalah dicantumkan di laporan

steps.en: Notices put on hold are all listed in the report
steps.id: Notice yang ditahan semuanya dicantumkan di laporan
steps.why_en: Some held notices were left out of the held-notices tab.
steps.why_id: Sebagian notice yang ditahan tidak masuk di tab notice tertahan.

steps.en: The report lands on the OIC's dashboard
steps.why_en: It goes out by email, not to a dashboard.
steps.why_id: Laporan dikirim lewat email, bukan ke dashboard.

steps.en: The OIC can download the report from the staff portal
steps.id: OIC bisa mengunduh laporan dari portal staf
steps.why_en: Download exists, but it gives nothing on days without held notices.
steps.why_id: Unduhan tersedia, tetapi tidak menghasilkan apa-apa pada hari tanpa notice tertahan.
